description: constraints.npm: keep Renovate's lockfile updates on npm 11, the major CI (Node 24) and local dev use. npm 12 fails `npm install --package-lock-only` with EALLOWREMOTE on registry tarballs when the tree has a package with bundleDependencies (Tailwind 4's @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi): npm/cli#9800. Remove once that is fixed and we move to npm 12.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm updates into a single PR (shares package-lock.json + npmDepsHash, so separate PRs conflict).
Group all non-major Go module updates into a single PR (shares go.sum + vendorHash, so separate PRs conflict).
